warnings: Two different biostimulants tested (Kelpak SL seaweed extract and Terra Sorb Complex amino acids) - must extract each separately vs control
Factorial design with concentration (lower/higher) and application frequency (single/double) creates multiple treatment combinations
Three-year study (2016-2018) with separate results per year - need to extract year-specific data
Yield data in Figure 1 appears to be the primary outcome but values need careful extraction
Economic analysis data in Figures 3-4 should not be confused with yield data
Tables 1-2 contain secondary outcomes (biochemical parameters) not primary yield data

recon.variance_source: Values followed by different small letters are significantly different at p < 0.05. Standard deviation value (SD) was determined.
recon.control_definition: Plants sprayed with water (being a solvent to the biostimulants used) served as the control
recon.treatment_definition: Bean plants were treated with Kelpak SL (seaweed extracts) and Terra Sorb Complex (free amino acids) in single and double spraying with two solution concentrations
recon.potential_tc_confusion: Risk of confusing the two different biostimulant products - Kelpak SL vs Terra Sorb Complex must be extracted separately
recon.sample_size_source: The experiment was established in a random block system, in 4 replications
recon.extraction_guidance: Primary yield data is in Figure 1 only. Extract yield (g m⁻²) for each biostimulant (Kelpak SL and Terra Sorb Complex) separately, with 4 treatment combinations each (LSS, LDS, HSS, HDS) vs control (C). Data shown by year (2016-2018) with average ± SD. Tables 1-2 contain secondary biochemical outcomes only. Economic data in Figures 3-4 should not be extracted for yield analysis.

table_descriptions.Table 1: Effect of biostimulants treatment on nutraceutical quality (protein, FRAP, ABTS, proline)
table_descriptions.Table 2: Effect of biostimulants treatment on the antioxidant potential in common bean seeds (anthocyanins, flavonoids, reducing power, total phenols)
table_descriptions.Table 3: Plant developmental stages and dates of biostimulant application (methodology table)
